snippet.title: Free Ball - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

Learn more: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freeball/free-ball-3rd-person-volleyball-game-with-special-abilities
